title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.22448v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. translated_title: Lean4AgenticRL：通过可验证的多层次过程奖励推进智能体强化学习
translated_abstract: 提升大型语言模型（LLM）应对复杂软件工程（SWE）及通用终端使用问题的智能体能力是一项紧迫挑战。当前最先进的LLM通常经过大规模的智能体强化学习（RL）训练，但它们大多依赖高层的结果奖励，极少考虑低层的工具调用奖励和中层的工作流阶段奖励，导致训练效果不佳。为克服这一局限，我们提出Lean4AgenticRL，据我们所知，这是首个在开放式智能体强化学习中将多层次过程奖励锚定于统一Lean4形式化模式的框架。Lean4AgenticRL首先构建了一个针对特定问题的工作流系统，在执行过程中平衡智能体自身能力与可控性，为进一步验证奠定基础。随后，我们的工作流形式化与多层次奖励标注（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 提出Lean4AgenticRL框架，首次将覆盖低层工具调用、中层工作流阶段和高层结果的统一多层次过程奖励锚定在Lean4形式化模式上，从而有效提升LLM开放式智能体强化学习的训练效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes Lean4AgenticRL, the first framework grounding unified multi-level process rewards (from low-level tool calls to high-level outcomes) in the Lean4 formalization schema to improve open-ended agentic reinforcement learning for LLMs.
